note: M4.1 game values, decided without the owner (asleep; listed for his review): a round passing within 4 m of a man adds up to 0.3 suppression (heavier rounds more: square root of energy over 1,700 J, between x0.25 and x2; half as much at 4 m as at 0 m); a round striking near him counts at the distance of its impact; a burst within 1.5 x its stun radius adds up to 0.8. Suppression fades 0.1 per second (tuned with the suppression lab: a fire team at 200 m pins the men it fires at within about 6 s, a machine gun within 1-2 s, at 600 m within about 8 s; one aimed rifle rarely pins). At 0.6 he is pinned (prone, does not move, fires at a third of the rate) until it falls below 0.35. Stress grows by 0.02 per second x suppression, +0.15 for a comrade falling within 60 m, +0.2 when his leader falls, +0.25 x severity for his own wound; experience damps it (x(1 - 0.6 x experience)), his leader within 30 m too (x0.7). Under light fire (suppression below 0.3) it fades 0.01 per second. Stress over 0.3 cautious, 0.55 shaken (fires at 0.7 the rate), 0.85 panicked (lies flat, does not fire) until it is back under 0.7. M4.2 (same terms): a man fires on his own at an enemy he sees within 400 m (rifle), 600 m (magnified sight of 4x or more) or 800 m (machine gun) — under the default rule 'return' only once his unit has been fired upon in the last 30 s (a cease-fire order holds until it is fired upon again); under fire (suppression from 0.1) and not covered from the enemy he knows, he runs to cover within 15 m (preferring a spot where he can fire over it kneeling), at most every 20 s; a man out of spare magazines or belts gets one from the nearest comrade within 30 m who has more than 2 (or carries them for him), handed over in 3 s. M4.3 (owner: panicked men cower; a broken unit runs back): a unit on the move that comes under fire anew halts and takes cover; an assault goes in two halves bounding 30 m at a time (one fires at the objective while the other runs, swapping when the runners are down, or after 40 s), the last 25 m all together; a withdrawal bounds back the same way, the halt covering towards the enemy; a unit breaks when half its able men panic: they run 150 m away from the enemy they know and rally once nothing has been fired at them for 30 s (stress x0.6). M5.1 standing rules (owner 2026-11-12): ammunition discipline stretches the time between shots or bursts x1.8 (conserve) or shortens it x0.6 (maximum); 'fall back' on contact withdraws the unit 100 m away from the enemy it knows. Surrender (owner 2026-11-12): a conscious wounded man who can no longer fight (whether or not he can still walk) gives up when an enemy he has seen or been told of in the last 10 s (decisions.contactLostSeconds) is within 50 m and no fit comrade (able, can walk and fight, not panicked or routed) is within 30 m; a panicked or routed man gives up when such an enemy is within 30 m; a fit enemy within 3 m takes a surrendered man prisoner; each man reconsiders once a second. When things are quiet (his unit not fired upon for 10 s), one fit enemy within 50 m who has seen the surrender walks over, takes the man prisoner and returns to where he was; he gives the errand up after 120 s. Game values from the owner's approximate distances, the same for every faction; 0 switches a rule off. Attackers (owner 2026-11-12, after M6.6): men of the attacking side, and men of any unit in an assault, do not give up when panicked or routed (they run back instead); a wounded attacker who cannot fight gives up only with a known enemy within 25 m.
